Workflows.title: Search for a Job and Attempt to Apply
Workflows.goal: A user should be able to search for jobs, apply various filters, view the details of a specific job, and begin the application process. The scenario is complete when the user is presented with the government login page.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://merkava.mrp.gov.il/giusp/index.html#/search-results
2. Click the 'מיקום' (Location) filter button.
3. Select the 'ירושלים' (Jerusalem) checkbox.
4. Click the 'תחום' (Field) filter button.
5. Select the 'בריאות' (Health) checkbox.
6. Click the 'משרד' (Office) filter button.
7. Select the 'משרד הבריאות' (Ministry of Health) checkbox.
8. Click the 'פרטים נוספים' (More details) button on a job listing.
9. On the job details page, click the 'הגשת מועמדות' (Submit Application) button.

Workflows.title: Attempt to Start a Job Application from a Direct Link (Fails)
Workflows.goal: A user navigating directly to a job posting should be able to start the application process. The test will verify if the application form loads. Success: The application form loads. Failure: The page times out or shows an error.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to a specific job page, e.g., https://merkava.mrp.gov.il/giusp/index.html#/position/07378533
2. Click the 'הגשת מועמדות' (Submit Application) button.
3. Observe that the page times out and becomes blank, blocking the application process.

Workflows.title: Submit an Inquiry via the User Support Form
Workflows.goal: A user should be able to open the support modal, navigate to the online inquiry form, fill in all required fields, and submit the form. The test checks if the form can be submitted.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://merkava.mrp.gov.il/giusp/index.html#
2. Click the 'כאן בשבילכם' (Here for you) support button.
3. Click the 'פנייה מקוונת' (Online Inquiry) button.
4. In the new tab, select 'בקשה למידע' (Request for information) from the 'נושא ראשי' (Main Subject) dropdown.
5. Select 'בירור סטטוס' (Status inquiry) from the 'נושא משני' (Secondary Subject) dropdown.
6. Fill the 'פרטי הפנייה' (Inquiry details) with 'Test inquiry details'.
7. Fill the 'שם פרטי' (First name) with 'Test'.
8. Fill the 'שם משפחה' (Last name) with 'User'.
9. Fill the 'תעודת זהות' (ID card) with '123456789'.
10. Fill the 'טלפון' (Phone) with '0501234567'.
11. Fill the 'דוא"ל' (Email) with 'test@example.com'.
12. Check the confirmation checkbox 'למיטב ידיעתי הפרטים שמסרתי בטופס זה נכונים.'
13. Click the 'שליחה' (Send) button.
